description: Land Acquisition - Damme, Elapatha D/S Division, Rathnapura District and Boossa, Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific parcels of land (including location descriptions, boundaries, plot numbers, and extents) for public purposes, with procedures for compensation claims. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
